messages:
Rina - Sales: quick follow-up from all-hands re: partner-driven pipeline. a few AEs asked whether partner-influenced deals should get priority in weekly forecast reviews. what do we want the standard to be?
Marta - Partnerships: my take: mark partner-influenced opps but don't overweight them automatically. suggest a separate weekly partner review where we triage these deals with a partner rep + AE. keeps main forecast clean but gives focus.
Omar - RevOps: agree with a parallel review. operationally we'll add a boolean field 'partner_influenced' in CRM and a filtered view. also propose a rolling 30-day hang tag for recently influenced deals so we can measure velocity change.
Priya - Product: from product side, if partners get prioritized we should ensure enablement materials are available quickly. propose a 1-pager kit + one-click demo link for AEs to share. engineering can support the demo link generation in 4 business days.
Rina - Sales: separate review sounds good. timeline: if we can get the CRM tag + view by next Tue, AEs can start tagging this week.
Marta - Partnerships: will run the partner review invite cadence (weekly 30m) and include partner reps. aim to start next Wed.
Omar - RevOps: CRM change ETA: 3 business days. I'll add the filtered dashboard tile for partner funnel coverage as well.
Chris (CEO): solid plan. keep the pilot small, measure win-rate delta and time-to-close. prefer objective triggers for tagging (e.g., source == partner OR partner_contact_email present).
all-hands-bot: slides + notes uploaded: https://redwood.company/all-hands/1769990001. Please annotate with action items.
Rina - Sales: thanks everyone. I'll circulate the AE guidance and sample message to partners. meeting invite for weekly partner review to follow. :thumbsup:
